title: Model third European compact OBJ source
changes: Add a strict source-authenticated sparse model for the caller-witnessed compact OBJ bank at 6bf490, preserving its empty list and original guest indexing.
validation: Fresh isolated Windows build and focused Wine test passed all source bytes and gaps, JSON and tamper checks, and original sequence, frame and list reader prefixes; protected inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: The first build stopped before compilation when a temporary cache copy exceeded quota; only incomplete and superseded cache copies were removed. Runtime publication, ordinary use, unwitnessed data, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
